newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan seizes ship of suspected Chinese illegals.
newsitem.headline: Japan seizes ship of suspected Chinese illegals.

text.p: Maritime authorities detained a ship with 91 Chinese passengers and crew off Japan's Pacific coast on Saturday in the fifth seizure of the week of vessels suspected of smuggling illegal immigrants, officials said.

A Japanese patrol boat intercepted the estimated 100-tonne ship off Ashizuri cape, 625 km (390 miles) southwest of Tokyo, early on Saturday after a naval vessel spotted the craft, a Maritime Safety Agency (MSA) official said.
The ship left the southern Chinese province of Fujian last Sunday, MSA quoted passengers as saying. The passengers included 20 women.
The ship is the fifth vessel to be intercepted and detained off Japan's Pacific coast since Sunday for carrying what Japanese authorities suspect are illegal immigrants from the Chinese mainland.

The wave of seizures has prompted the MSA to heighten vigilance over the Pacific coast at a time when maritime authorities are also grappling with damage caused when Russian tanker Nakhodka sank last month, spilling 5,000 tonnes of oil on the Sea of Japan coast in the country's worst oil spill.
Authorities in the port of Yokohama on Saturday displayed a squalid Chinese fishing boat intercepted this week near Izu-Oshima Island in the Tokyo region.
The small boat held 38 Chinese who were arrested on suspicion of trying to enter Japan illegally.
